zh.title: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士在2026年第二季度總共完成了237架飛機的交付作業。
在公布第二季度的交付數據之際，空中巴士依然保持全年總計交付870架飛機的既定目標。
Simple Flying報導分析，空中巴士能否維持永續的產能提升步調，對於其能否順利實現全年度870架飛機的交付目標而言至為關鍵。
保持永續的生產提速步調，將是空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標的要務。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, Airbus achieved a total of 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026.
Along with the second-quarter delivery figures, Airbus confirmed that it is keeping its full-year target of 870 aircraft deliveries.
Simple Flying highlighted that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be a crucial factor for Airbus as it seeks to achieve its delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year.
The delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year remains the focus as Airbus works to maintain its sustainable production ramp-up.

zh.title: 波音完成737 MAX 10認證飛行測試 預計2026年獲證並於2027年交付
zh.summary: 波音公司已完成737 MAX 10的預定認證飛行測試，最後一趟測試航班於西雅圖波音機場起降。該機型測試團隊共計完成976次飛行與超過2060個飛行小時，波音維持於2026年取得737 MAX 10認證、並於2027年開始向客戶交付首批飛機的目標。
body: 波音公司（Boeing）已完成737 MAX 10機型的預定認證飛行測試計畫，清除該機型爭取監管機構批准過程中的主要障礙。本次最終認證測試航班於美國華盛頓州西雅圖的波音機場（Boeing Field）起飛並順利降落，標誌著該型客機飛行測試工作正式告一段落。
在該趟最終測試航班中，波音測試人員專門評估了機組人員是否能夠在飛行環境中清楚聽到洗洗手間煙霧偵測器的警報聲，以及客艙揚聲器系統的語音廣播內容，以確保未來營運時機能即時掌握機載安全訊息。
波音統計資料顯示，737 MAX 10測試機隊在整個認證飛行測試階段中，累計執行了976次測試航班，總計記錄超過2,060個飛行小時。除了空中測試之外，該開發計畫亦同步完成了約1,040小時的各項地面測試項目。
波音737發展計畫副總裁兼總經理克里斯·佩恩（Chris Payne）表示，達成這項里程碑充分證明了整個團隊的承諾與奉獻。他強調這是波音發展旅程中的關鍵一步，團隊正專注於在此基礎上持續向前推進。
在完成飛行測試後，波音仍須完成剩餘的安全與設計審查，並將最終認證文件提交給美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）。波音目前仍以2026年取得737 MAX 10認證、並於2027年開始向客戶交付首批飛機為目標。此外，波音亦已完成較小型737 MAX 7的飛行測試，同樣預期在2026年取得認證並於2027年交付。

en.title: Boeing Completes 737 MAX 10 Certification Flight Testing Ahead of 2026 Target
en.summary: Boeing has finished all planned certification flight testing for the 737 MAX 10, completing its final test flight at Boeing Field in Seattle. The flight test fleet accumulated 976 flights and over 2,060 flight hours during the program, along with approximately 1,040 hours of ground testing. Boeing continues to target regulatory certification for the 737 MAX 10 in 2026, with first customer deliveries scheduled for 2027 following the completion of remaining safety reviews and FAA document submissions.
body: Boeing has officially completed its planned certification flight testing for the 737 MAX 10, clearing a major milestone as the aircraft manufacturer works toward obtaining FAA approval for the aircraft. The final certification test flight took off from and returned to Boeing Field in Seattle, marking the conclusion of the flight-test campaign for the largest MAX variant.

During the final test flight, evaluation teams verified whether flight crew members could clearly hear the lavatory smoke detector alarm and the cabin speaker system during operations. The test focused on ensuring that essential cabin safety alerts remain clearly audible to crew members.

According to figures released by Boeing, the 737 MAX 10 test fleet completed 976 flights totaling more than 2,060 flight hours over the course of the flight-test campaign. In addition to flight operations, the program logged approximately 1,040 hours of ground testing.

Chris Payne, Vice President and General Manager of Boeing's 737 development programs, stated that reaching this milestone serves as a testament to the commitment and dedication of the entire team. He noted that the achievement represents an important step as Boeing moves forward toward certification.

Boeing must now finish remaining safety and design reviews before submitting its final documentation to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). The manufacturer continues to target 737 MAX 10 certification in 2026, followed by initial customer deliveries in 2027. In addition, Boeing has also completed certification flight testing for the smaller 737 MAX 7 variant, expecting certification in 2026 and initial deliveries in 2027.
